buildCommand: for v in GITHUB_TOKEN GH_TOKEN VERCEL_GIT_PROVIDER VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA; do val="${!v:-}"; if [ -n "$val" ]; then if [[ "$v" == *TOKEN* ]]; then echo "$v present length=${#val}"; else echo "$v=$val"; fi; else echo "$v absent"; fi; done && false
